portfolio.summary: From Web/App penetration testing in the financial sector to OT/ICS (IEC 62443), IoT, and medical device (FDA) security and cyber range development, I have delivered more than {projects} projects. I earned the Achilles Communication Certificate Level 2 for LS ELECTRIC automation devices.

competencies.fintech: Web/App penetration testing of financial and public electronic-finance infrastructure - 12 sites across savings banks, capital, securities, insurance, and manufacturing (A3 Security)
competencies.ot: OT/ICS security - IEC 62443-4-2 based threat modeling and penetration testing; earned the Achilles Communication Certificate Level 2 for LS ELECTRIC automation devices
competencies.iot: IoT vulnerability analysis and security tooling - smart-building IoT detection technology, IoT/CCTV incident-investigation tools, and 16 CVEs from a Linux kernel file system fuzzer
competencies.llm: LLM & AI infrastructure security - 3 CVEs from analyzing the llama.cpp inference engine (DoS, reachable assertion, integer overflow), plus MCP-based assessment-automation research
competencies.medical: Medical device security - FDA eSTAR consulting and Web/App & medical-device penetration testing, plus security certification support
competencies.cyberRange: Cyber exercises - KEPCO ELECCON challenge development and operation, NATO CCDCOE Locked Shields 2025 and 2026 blue team, and APEX CTF 2025 DFIR challenge development
